observation.visible_scene: Nighttime urban street covered with piled snow. On the left is a brightly lit storefront/market area with purple, blue and white neon glow and dark silhouettes of pedestrians; a small tree, yellow marker posts and a glowing blue diamond-shaped light sit in the middle ground. A bare tree trunk stands in the right foreground. On the right is a darker multi-story building with rows of windows, two cylindrical illuminated advertising displays, a warm street lamp, a parked dark car, and (later) a red sign/barrier structure.
visible_changes: The view undergoes a continuous rightward pan / lateral shift (consistent with a camera moving along the street): every fixed world object drifts leftward across the frames.
The neon-lit storefront and the blue diamond light slide out of the left edge of the frame over the sequence.

The foreground tree trunk moves from the right side (≈x880 in frame 1) to the left edge (≈x20 in frame 41), exiting the frame; the yellow posts likewise drift left and leave the view, showing stronger parallax than the background, indicating they are closer to the camera.
The dark building on the right, its windows, the two cylindrical advertising displays, the street lamp and the red sign progressively enter from the right and move toward the center.
A parked dark car near the snow pile shifts leftward in frame position (≈x680 frame 12 → ≈x270 frame 30), consistent with camera motion rather than the car moving.
Pedestrian silhouettes in the lit area shift left and out of frame with the pan; no clear independent walking motion is resolvable due to blur.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the camera is mounted on a moving vehicle or simply panning, and the vehicle's travel direction/speed, are not determined by the frames.
The state of the scene before frame 1 and after frame 41 (the pan is already in progress at the start and continues at the end).
Whether any pedestrians are actively walking or standing, given the low resolution and motion blur.
uncertain_details: Individual pedestrian motion cannot be distinguished from the global camera pan.
Exact identities/contents of the illuminated advertising panels are too blurry to read.
The parked car's status (engine on/off, occupants) is not visible.
